_provenance.data: tests/replication/data/spec22_panel.csv, versionne avec le test. Genere par validation/external/spec22_make_panel.py (graine 20260828) et bit-identique a la copie lue par le script R. Synthetique a dessein : aucune donnee tierce n'est redistribuee. Il est versionne ICI et non dans validation/, qui est gitignore — un fichier absent aurait transforme ce test de non-regression en skip silencieux.
_provenance.design: ARDL(1,1) with an intercept, y ~ y_l1 + x + x_l1, N=30, T=60
_provenance.tolerance_note: The spec asks for 1e-4. The measured agreement is 5.6e-16, so the contract is set at 1e-10: tight enough that any real change in the aggregation breaks it, loose enough to survive BLAS reordering across platforms.
_provenance.independent_check: Same comparison on the Produc panel (Munnell 1990, 48 US states, T=17), redistributed with plm and therefore NOT shipped here: agreement to 4.5e-14 on all four coefficients and standard errors. Run locally; see the session log.
